Notifications contain the repository, review number, attention category and unread count. They never include titles, source code or comment text. Choosing a notification selects that review in Home.

Your operating system controls permission and presentation. BetterPullReview cannot confirm every system permission setting.

The selected host determines which agent profiles are allowed. Choices here apply to the next explicit request in the current review; they are not saved as global defaults. Private notes, the current draft and uncommitted work are included only when selected. Start the request from the review's agent panel.

Local data includes repository caches, retained review history, drafts, notes, receipts and preferences. Retained epochs remain until explicitly pruned; maintenance can remove revisions needed for an older comparison. Moving this storage location and global purge are not available in this build.

History maintenance above is limited to the selected review or repository cache and asks for confirmation. It does not change GitHub or your working copy. Diagnostic preview and local export are available in the profile controls. Removing the application does not remove its local data folder or system credential entries. Use Accounts & Hosts to sign out of remembered device sessions.
Diagnostics are local and available without signing in. Start with a preview.
